title: 5 days to calmer exams
description: Small daily steps for exam stress. General self-care ideas, not medical treatment.

days.title: Name the worry
days.task: Write down your three biggest exam worries, one line each.

days.title: Plan small
days.task: Pick one topic, study it for 25 minutes, then take a 5-minute break.

days.title: Move a little
days.task: Take a 10-minute walk or stretch before you study.

days.title: Slow breathing
days.task: Do three rounds on the Breathe page before you start studying.

days.title: Look back
days.task: Write one thing you handled better this week than you expected.

title: 5 days to better sleep habits
description: Simple habits that help many people sleep. If sleep problems continue, please talk to a doctor.

days.title: Fix a wake-up time
days.task: Choose a wake-up time you can keep every day this week.

days.title: Screens off
days.task: Put screens away 30 minutes before bed tonight.

days.title: Wind down
days.task: Do 5 minutes of slow breathing or gentle stretching before bed.

days.title: Ease off caffeine
days.task: Avoid tea, coffee and energy drinks after 4 pm today.

days.title: Notice and note
days.task: Write down how you slept and one thing that helped.

title: 7 days of calming worry
description: Everyday skills for racing thoughts. This is self-help practice, not treatment. If worry feels overwhelming, please talk to a doctor or counsellor.

days.title: Notice your body
days.task: Sit quietly for 2 minutes and notice where you feel tension. Just notice, do not fix it.

days.title: Slow breathing
days.task: Do three rounds on the Breathe page.

days.title: Grounding 5-4-3-2-1
days.task: Try the 5-4-3-2-1 grounding exercise on the Breathe page.

days.title: Worry time
days.task: Pick a 10-minute window today for worries. When one appears outside it, jot it down and postpone it.

days.title: Fact or feeling
days.task: Take one worry and write what you know for sure and what you are guessing.

days.title: Move it out
days.task: Walk, stretch or dance for 10 minutes to release some nervous energy.

days.title: Reflect
days.task: Write which skill helped most this week and plan to use it again.

title: 5 days of self-kindness
description: Practise talking to yourself the way you would talk to a good friend.

days.title: Catch the critic
days.task: Notice one harsh thought about yourself today and write it down.

days.title: Friend voice
days.task: Rewrite that thought the way you would say it to a friend.

days.title: Small comfort
days.task: Do one small comforting thing for yourself: tea, music, a shower, a rest.

days.title: Done list
days.task: Write 3 things you did today, however small, and give yourself credit.

days.title: Kind note
days.task: Write a short, kind note to yourself for a hard day and keep it somewhere easy to find.

title: 5 days of staying connected
description: Gentle ways to feel less alone, one small reach-out at a time.

days.title: Think of someone
days.task: Write down two people you feel at ease with, even if you have not spoken in a while.

days.title: Say hello
days.task: Send one of them a short message, even just a greeting.

days.title: Be around people
days.task: Spend 15 minutes somewhere with other people nearby: a park, library or canteen.

days.title: Share one thing
days.task: Tell someone you trust one honest thing about how your week has been.

days.title: Plan something
days.task: Make one small plan with a friend or family member for the coming week.

title: 5 days to steadier focus
description: Habits that make studying feel lighter and less overwhelming.

days.title: One clear goal
days.task: Write the single most important thing to finish today.

days.title: Phone away
days.task: Study for 25 minutes with your phone in another room.

days.title: Break it down
days.task: Split one big task into 3 small steps and finish the first.

days.title: Mind reset
days.task: Take a 5-minute break with water and a stretch, then restart.

days.title: End of day
days.task: Write what you finished and what comes first tomorrow.
